description: Canonical registry of KYBERION_* environment variables (OP-05). Regenerate with pnpm generate:env-registry; curated fields are preserved.

entries.name: KYBERION_A2A_SECRET
entries.description: Shared secret used to sign and verify A2A envelopes; values stay in the secret store.

entries.name: KYBERION_A2A_SIGNATURE
entries.description: A2A envelope signature policy: warn audits missing signatures while enforce rejects unsigned or unknown-sender messages.

entries.name: KYBERION_A2UI_BRIDGE_URL
entries.description: Optional A2UI rendering bridge endpoint used by the presence actuator; keep it on an approved local or trusted surface and do not treat it as an authorization boundary.

entries.name: KYBERION_AGENT_BOOT_READY_TIMEOUT_MS
entries.description: Milliseconds an agent adapter waits for a newly started runtime to become ready before failing the boot request.

entries.name: KYBERION_AGENT_ID
entries.description: Logical agent identity attached to runtime, task, and audit records; use a stable non-secret identifier.

entries.name: KYBERION_AGENT_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS
entries.description: Milliseconds an inactive agent runtime may remain before lifecycle cleanup; the default is 20 minutes.

entries.name: KYBERION_AGENT_INFLIGHT_LIMIT
entries.description: Maximum concurrent requests admitted for one agent runtime; excess work receives a bounded busy response.

entries.name: KYBERION_AGENT_RING
entries.description: Numeric policy ring supplied to operation-policy evaluation; higher rings may have stricter execution rules.

entries.name: KYBERION_AGENT_RUNTIME_SUPERVISOR_HOST
entries.description: Bind host for the agent runtime supervisor daemon; the default is loopback so the local control endpoint is not exposed remotely by omission.

entries.name: KYBERION_AGENT_RUNTIME_SUPERVISOR_LOCK_PATH
entries.description: Lock-file path used to prevent duplicate agent runtime supervisor daemons; keep it in the governed runtime area.

entries.name: KYBERION_AGENT_RUNTIME_SUPERVISOR_PORT
entries.description: TCP port for the agent runtime supervisor when transport is tcp; zero permits the operating system to select a port.

entries.name: KYBERION_AGENT_RUNTIME_SUPERVISOR_SOCKET_PATH
entries.description: Unix-domain socket path for local agent runtime supervisor RPC; keep it under the governed runtime area.

entries.name: KYBERION_AGENT_RUNTIME_SUPERVISOR_TOKEN
entries.description: Shared token for newline-JSON agent runtime supervisor RPC.

entries.name: KYBERION_AGENT_RUNTIME_SUPERVISOR_TRANSPORT
entries.description: Transport used by the agent runtime supervisor; unix is the local default, while tcp requires an explicitly controlled host and port.

entries.name: KYBERION_AGENT_TIER
entries.description: Execution authority tier propagated to secure-io and policy checks; child processes may downgrade but must not use it to bypass governed access.

entries.name: KYBERION_AGENT_TURN_TIMEOUT_MS
entries.description: Maximum milliseconds allowed for one agent conversation turn before the mediator returns a timeout.

entries.name: KYBERION_AGY_AGENT
entries.description: Generated AGY workspace agent name selected for CLI sessions, for example kyberion-reviewer.

entries.name: KYBERION_AGY_CLI_MODEL
entries.description: Model name passed to the AGY CLI backend.

entries.name: KYBERION_AGY_SDK_API_KEY
entries.description: Internal bridge transport for the Antigravity SDK API key; prefer GEMINI_API_KEY or GOOGLE_API_KEY in the parent environment.

entries.name: KYBERION_AGY_SDK_CWD
entries.description: Working directory passed from the AGY SDK adapter to its Python bridge.

entries.name: KYBERION_AGY_SDK_PYTHON
entries.description: Python 3.10+ interpreter used by the official google-antigravity SDK bridge.

entries.name: KYBERION_ALLOW_FILE_SECRETS
entries.description: Acknowledge the plaintext file-secret fallback when the OS keychain is unavailable (warn-phase; see AC-05).

entries.name: KYBERION_ALLOW_LOCAL_NETWORK
entries.description: Allow explicitly opted-in development flows to reach local or private network addresses; disabled by default.

entries.name: KYBERION_ALLOW_STUB_FALLBACK
entries.description: Keep the reasoning stub fallback when the configured provider chain is unavailable; disabled by default.

entries.name: KYBERION_ALLOW_TEST_NOTIFICATIONS
entries.description: Allow operator notification delivery during tests; test-only opt-in.

entries.name: KYBERION_ALLOW_UNAUTH_REMOTE
entries.description: Allow unauthenticated remote Chronos readonly access only when no API or localadmin token is configured; disabled by default.

entries.name: KYBERION_ALLOW_UNSAFE_CLI
entries.description: Allow the service actuator to execute CLI commands; disabled by default.

entries.name: KYBERION_ALLOW_UNSAFE_JS
entries.description: Allow code or system actuators to evaluate JavaScript; disabled by default.

entries.name: KYBERION_ALLOW_UNSAFE_SHELL
entries.description: Allow shell execution by code, system, or network actuators; disabled by default.

entries.name: KYBERION_ANTHROPIC_FAST_MODEL
entries.description: Fast model override for the Anthropic API route.

entries.name: KYBERION_ANTHROPIC_MODEL
entries.description: Model override for the Anthropic API route.

entries.name: KYBERION_API_TOKEN
entries.description: Bearer token for authenticated surface/API requests.

entries.name: KYBERION_AUDIO_PERMISSION_CONFIRMED
entries.description: Operator acknowledgement that the meeting preflight microphone permission was confirmed for this session; use 1 only after the OS permission check succeeds.

entries.name: KYBERION_AUDIO_RECORD_COMMAND
entries.description: Local microphone capture command used by the voice sample recorder; it receives governed template values such as output and duration and is not a general-purpose user command entrypoint.

entries.name: KYBERION_AUDIT_CHAIN_KEY
entries.description: HMAC key used to authenticate the append-only audit chain; values stay in the secret store.

entries.name: KYBERION_AUDIT_FORWARDER_COMMAND
entries.description: Optional shell sink for forwarding audit events after the governed audit sink records them locally; use an explicitly approved command.

entries.name: KYBERION_AUDIT_FORWARDER_URL
entries.description: Optional HTTP destination for forwarding audit events; outbound delivery remains subject to the egress policy and local audit persistence is authoritative.

entries.name: KYBERION_AUTO_SEAL
entries.description: Automatically seal completed personal-tier missions.

entries.name: KYBERION_AUTONOMOUS_OPS_POLICY_PATH
entries.description: Optional path override for the autonomous-operations policy catalog; the selected catalog remains schema-validated before an operation is admitted.

entries.name: KYBERION_BACKUP_PASSPHRASE
entries.description: Passphrase used to encrypt and restore backup archives; keep it in an external secret manager and never store it in the archive or registry.

entries.name: KYBERION_BLUEBUBBLES_PASSWORD
entries.description: Password used to authenticate requests to the BlueBubbles server.

entries.name: KYBERION_BLUEBUBBLES_URL
entries.description: Base URL of the local or approved BlueBubbles bridge used for iMessage operations; it configures transport only and does not grant tenant access.

entries.name: KYBERION_BLUEBUBBLES_WEBHOOK_SECRET
entries.description: Shared secret used to authenticate inbound BlueBubbles webhook requests.

entries.name: KYBERION_CLAUDE_CLI_BIN
entries.description: Path override for the claude CLI binary.

entries.name: KYBERION_CLAUDE_CLI_MODEL
entries.description: Model name passed to the Claude CLI backend.

entries.name: KYBERION_CLAUDE_FAST_MODEL
entries.description: Compatibility-alias fast model override for Claude routes.

entries.name: KYBERION_CLAUDE_MODEL
entries.description: Compatibility-alias model override for Claude routes.

entries.name: KYBERION_CLAUDE_NATIVE_SUBAGENT
entries.description: Set to 1 to delegate through Claude's provider-native sub-agents (one shared stream-json CLI session / SDK `agents`) instead of spawning `claude -p` per task. Fails closed with subagent_unavailable when a delegation cannot be observed.

entries.name: KYBERION_CODEX_CLI_MODEL
entries.description: Model name passed to the Codex CLI backend.

entries.name: KYBERION_CODEX_MODEL
entries.description: Model identifier used by the Codex agent and intent compiler routes.

entries.name: KYBERION_CODEX_MODEL_PROVIDER
entries.description: Provider hint paired with the Codex model identifier for app-server execution.

entries.name: KYBERION_COMFY_BASE_URL
entries.description: Base URL for the ComfyUI image or video generation provider; requests must remain within the governed provider and egress boundaries.

entries.name: KYBERION_COPILOT_MODEL
entries.description: Model name requested from the Copilot ACP backend.

entries.name: KYBERION_CURATION_REPORT_PATH
entries.description: Optional output path for the knowledge curation report; use a governed shared runtime or report location rather than a tenant-unscoped data directory.

entries.name: KYBERION_CURATION_TENANT_ROOTDIR
entries.description: Test and controlled-operation root override for tenant curation ledger discovery; it is resolved through the governed root resolver and must not be used to widen tenant scope.

entries.name: KYBERION_CUSTOMER
entries.description: Active customer profile slug used to resolve the profile root.

entries.name: KYBERION_DELEGATION_DEPTH
entries.description: Delegation hop depth propagated to child processes for policy limits; operator-started roots default to zero.

entries.name: KYBERION_DELEGATION_KILL_GRACE_MS
entries.description: Milliseconds between SIGTERM and SIGKILL when a delegated child exceeds its wall-clock budget; the default is 5 seconds.

entries.name: KYBERION_DELEGATION_MAX_CONCURRENCY
entries.description: Global maximum number of concurrent delegated tasks admitted by the process semaphore; the default is 4.

entries.name: KYBERION_DELEGATION_NOTIFICATIONS_PATH
entries.description: Override path for durable delegation notifications; keep it inside the governed shared runtime area.

entries.name: KYBERION_DELEGATION_PROVIDER_CAPS
entries.description: Optional JSON object mapping provider ids to positive concurrency caps, for example {"claude":3}; invalid JSON is ignored.

entries.name: KYBERION_DELEGATION_PROVIDER_MAX_CONCURRENCY
entries.description: Default maximum concurrent delegated tasks per provider when no provider-specific cap is configured; the default is 2.

entries.name: KYBERION_DELEGATION_STORE_DIR
entries.description: Directory for durable delegation task records; keep it within governed shared runtime storage.

entries.name: KYBERION_DELEGATION_SUMMARY_RETRY
entries.description: Enables the continuation retry when a delegated final summary is too brief; set false, 0, or off only for controlled compatibility runs.

entries.name: KYBERION_DELEGATION_TRACE_PATH
entries.description: Override path for delegated-task trace records used for observability and replay; keep it in governed runtime storage.

entries.name: KYBERION_DELEGATION_WALL_CLOCK_MS
entries.description: Wall-clock budget per delegated task before timeout and child termination; the default is 10 minutes.

entries.name: KYBERION_DEPLOY_COMMAND
entries.description: Optional shell deployment adapter command for CI/CD dispatch; real deployment remains behind the deployment approval gate and explicit configuration.

entries.name: KYBERION_DISABLE_AGENT_RUNTIME_SUPERVISOR_DAEMON
entries.description: Disable the agent runtime supervisor daemon for controlled local or test runs.

entries.name: KYBERION_DISABLE_EMBEDDINGS
entries.description: Disable embedding generation and use the non-semantic retrieval path.

entries.name: KYBERION_EGRESS_POLICY
entries.description: Network egress policy override; use warn to observe or enforce to reject destinations outside the governed allowlist. The policy file remains authoritative for domains.

entries.name: KYBERION_EGRESS_POLICY_PATH
entries.description: Optional path to the governed egress-policy catalog; keep it in an approved knowledge or deployment configuration location.

entries.name: KYBERION_ENABLE_SERVICE_ACTUATE_TOOL
entries.description: Enable the service-actuate tool for trusted operators after capability approval.

entries.name: KYBERION_ENTITY_GOVERNANCE_STRICT_WARNINGS
entries.description: Fail check:entity-governance when observed warnings exist.

entries.name: KYBERION_ENV_REGISTRY_STRICT
entries.description: Strict startup validation of KYBERION_* variables; on by default. Set to 0/false to downgrade unregistered or mistyped variables to warnings. Register new names in env-registry.json via pnpm generate:env-registry.

entries.name: KYBERION_ENV_REGISTRY_STRICT_DOCS
entries.description: Generator-only strictness: when enabled, the env-registry drift check also fails while any registry entry remains undocumented. Off by default; independent of KYBERION_ENV_REGISTRY_STRICT (CLI startup validation).

entries.name: KYBERION_FLUID_AUDIO_STT_COMMAND
entries.description: Local FluidAudio/Parakeet JSON bridge command for speech-to-text; the bridge receives a governed audio path and returns structured transcription output.

entries.name: KYBERION_GATE_OVERRIDE_SIGNATURE
entries.description: Human-override signature policy: warn observes missing or invalid gate signatures while enforce rejects them.

entries.name: KYBERION_GEMINI_CLI_MODEL
entries.description: Model name passed to the Gemini CLI backend.

entries.name: KYBERION_GEMINI_FAST_MODEL
entries.description: Fast model override for the Gemini route.

entries.name: KYBERION_GEMINI_MODEL
entries.description: Model identifier used by the Gemini API and routing fallback.

entries.name: KYBERION_GEMINI_URL
entries.description: Optional Gemini API base URL override; leave unset for the provider default and use only an endpoint permitted by the egress policy.

entries.name: KYBERION_GEMINI_VIDEO_API_KEY
entries.description: API key used by the explicit Google Veo video-generation backend.

entries.name: KYBERION_GEMINI_VIDEO_URL
entries.description: Optional base URL override for the Google Veo video-generation API.

entries.name: KYBERION_GROK_API_KEY
entries.description: xAI Grok API key for the grok-api reasoning backend. `XAI_API_KEY` is also accepted for compatibility.

entries.name: KYBERION_GROK_API_MODEL
entries.description: xAI Grok API model id. Defaults to grok-4.6 when omitted.

entries.name: KYBERION_GROK_API_URL
entries.description: Optional xAI-compatible API base URL; defaults to https://api.x.ai/v1.

entries.name: KYBERION_GROK_CLI_MODEL
entries.description: Model name passed to the Grok Build CLI backend.

entries.name: KYBERION_INTENT_COMPILER_MODEL
entries.description: Explicit model override for intent contract compilation.

entries.name: KYBERION_INTENT_COMPILER_MODEL_PROVIDER
entries.description: Provider hint paired with the intent compiler model override.

entries.name: KYBERION_INTENT_COMPILER_PROVIDER
entries.description: Provider route selected for intent contract compilation.

entries.name: KYBERION_KNOWLEDGE_FEEDBACK_DIR
entries.description: Override for scoped human-feedback and knowledge-gap JSONL storage (default active/shared/runtime/feedback-loop).

entries.name: KYBERION_KNOWLEDGE_TIER
entries.description: Knowledge tier hint propagated into pipeline facet resolution; accepted values are public, confidential, and personal, with invalid values falling back to public.

entries.name: KYBERION_LLAMACPP_KEY
entries.description: API key for the llama.cpp OpenAI-compatible backend, when authentication is enabled.

entries.name: KYBERION_LLAMACPP_MODEL
entries.description: Model identifier sent to the llama.cpp OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

entries.name: KYBERION_LLAMACPP_URL
entries.description: Base URL for the llama.cpp OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

entries.name: KYBERION_LM_STUDIO_MODEL
entries.description: Compatibility-alias model identifier sent to the LM Studio endpoint.

entries.name: KYBERION_LM_STUDIO_URL
entries.description: Compatibility-alias base URL for the LM Studio OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

entries.name: KYBERION_LMSTUDIO_KEY
entries.description: API key for the LM Studio OpenAI-compatible backend, when authentication is enabled.

entries.name: KYBERION_LMSTUDIO_MODEL
entries.description: Model identifier sent to the LM Studio OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

entries.name: KYBERION_LMSTUDIO_URL
entries.description: Base URL for the LM Studio OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

entries.name: KYBERION_LOCAL_LLM_KEY
entries.description: API key for the local LLM endpoint.

entries.name: KYBERION_LOCAL_LLM_MODEL
entries.description: Model id for the local LLM endpoint.

entries.name: KYBERION_LOCAL_LLM_URL
entries.description: Base URL of a local OpenAI-compatible LLM endpoint.

entries.name: KYBERION_LOCALADMIN_TOKEN
entries.description: Bearer token for the chronos localadmin control surface.

entries.name: KYBERION_LOCALAI_KEY
entries.description: API key for the LocalAI OpenAI-compatible backend, when authentication is enabled.

entries.name: KYBERION_LOCALAI_MODEL
entries.description: Model identifier sent to the LocalAI OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

entries.name: KYBERION_LOCALAI_URL
entries.description: Base URL for the LocalAI OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

entries.name: KYBERION_LOCALHOST_AUTOADMIN
entries.description: Allow loopback Chronos requests to use the compatibility localadmin principal when true or unset.

entries.name: KYBERION_MANIFEST_SIGNING_KEY
entries.description: HMAC-SHA256 key for environment manifest signatures. When set, loadEnvironmentManifest enforces valid signatures fail-closed; sign manifests with pnpm manifests:sign.

entries.name: KYBERION_MCP_CALLER_ROLE
entries.description: Server-bound MCP caller role checked against mcp-tool-catalog.json; client arguments cannot elevate it.

entries.name: KYBERION_MCP_NHI
entries.description: Server-bound NHI used to bind MCP event and approval scope.

entries.name: KYBERION_MCP_PRINCIPAL
entries.description: Server-bound principal name recorded for MCP request attribution.

entries.name: KYBERION_MCP_TENANT
entries.description: Server-bound tenant slug; a client-supplied tenant may only narrow this binding.

entries.name: KYBERION_MEET_EXTENSION_TOKEN
entries.description: Pre-shared token used to authenticate the Chrome meeting extension bridge.

entries.name: KYBERION_MESH_SHARED_SECRET
entries.description: Shared secret used to authenticate mesh delivery and peer coordination.

entries.name: KYBERION_MFLUX_MODEL
entries.description: Model identifier passed to the local mflux image-generation backend; it selects the model and does not configure a remote provider endpoint.

entries.name: KYBERION_MINIMAX_VIDEO_API_KEY
entries.description: API key used by the explicit MiniMax Hailuo video-generation backend.

entries.name: KYBERION_MINIMAX_VIDEO_URL
entries.description: Optional base URL override for the MiniMax Hailuo video-generation API.

entries.name: KYBERION_MLX_EMBED_MODEL
entries.description: Hugging Face model identifier used by the MLX embedding backend.

entries.name: KYBERION_MLX_KEY
entries.description: API key for the MLX OpenAI-compatible backend, when authentication is enabled.

entries.name: KYBERION_MLX_MODEL
entries.description: Model identifier sent to the MLX-LM OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

entries.name: KYBERION_MLX_URL
entries.description: Base URL for the MLX-LM OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

entries.name: KYBERION_MLX_WHISPER_MODEL
entries.description: Model identifier used by the managed MLX Whisper streaming adapter.

entries.name: KYBERION_NEMOTRON_KEY
entries.description: API key for the Nemotron OpenAI-compatible backend, when authentication is enabled.

entries.name: KYBERION_NEMOTRON_MODEL
entries.description: Model identifier sent to the Nemotron OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

entries.name: KYBERION_NEMOTRON_URL
entries.description: Base URL for the Nemotron OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

entries.name: KYBERION_NHI_ACTOR
entries.description: Non-human identity actor verification mode: off disables checks, warn audits violations, and enforce rejects unregistered, suspended, or retired actors; the default is warn.

entries.name: KYBERION_OAUTH_CALLBACK_HOST
entries.description: Bind host for the local OAuth callback surface; the default is loopback and a remote host should be used only with an explicitly secured deployment.

entries.name: KYBERION_OAUTH_CALLBACK_PORT
entries.description: Local TCP port for the OAuth callback surface; the default is 8787 and remote binding still requires the callback host and deployment security controls.

entries.name: KYBERION_OLLAMA_KEY
entries.description: API key for the Ollama OpenAI-compatible backend, when authentication is enabled.

entries.name: KYBERION_OLLAMA_MODEL
entries.description: Model name sent to the Ollama OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

entries.name: KYBERION_OLLAMA_URL
entries.description: Base URL for the Ollama OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

entries.name: KYBERION_OPENAI_MODEL
entries.description: Model identifier used as the OpenAI vision route fallback.

entries.name: KYBERION_OPENAI_VIDEO_API_KEY
entries.description: API key used by the explicit OpenAI Sora video-generation backend.

entries.name: KYBERION_OPENAI_VIDEO_URL
entries.description: Optional base URL override for the OpenAI Videos API.

entries.name: KYBERION_OPENAI_VISION_MODEL
entries.description: Model identifier used for OpenAI-compatible vision requests.

entries.name: KYBERION_OPENROUTER_COST_POLICY
entries.description: OpenRouter cost guard. `free-only` is the safe default; `paid-allowed` explicitly opts into paid inference.

entries.name: KYBERION_OPENROUTER_KEY
entries.description: OpenRouter API key. `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` is also accepted for compatibility.

entries.name: KYBERION_OPENROUTER_MODEL
entries.description: OpenRouter model id sent to the chat completions endpoint. Defaults to the free model router when omitted.

entries.name: KYBERION_OPENROUTER_PROFILE
entries.description: OpenRouter model selection profile: free-router, pinned :free model, or explicit model.

entries.name: KYBERION_OPENROUTER_REQUIRED_PARAMETERS
entries.description: Comma-separated OpenRouter supported parameters required by the selected model.

entries.name: KYBERION_OPENROUTER_URL
entries.description: Optional OpenRouter-compatible API base URL; defaults to https://openrouter.ai/api/v1.

entries.name: KYBERION_OPS_ALERT_WEBHOOK_URL
entries.description: Optional webhook destination for operational alerts; delivery is attempted only when configured and remains subject to egress policy, while the local alert ledger remains the source of record.

entries.name: KYBERION_OS_GUARDED_SURFACE_URL
entries.description: URL of the guarded OS decision surface shown to a human when an operating-system action is held; it is a presentation link, not an authorization input.

entries.name: KYBERION_PEER_HOST
entries.description: Bind host for the peer messaging and peer conversation servers; the default is loopback and remote binding requires the mesh transport security configuration.

entries.name: KYBERION_PEER_KEY_REF
entries.description: Secret reference recorded in peer enrollment; it identifies the secret without storing its value.

entries.name: KYBERION_PEER_SHARED_SECRET
entries.description: HMAC shared secret used to authenticate peer messaging.

entries.name: KYBERION_PERSONA
entries.description: Active persona for the policy engine (set by withExecutionContext; rarely set manually).

entries.name: KYBERION_PROVIDER_CAPABILITY_REFRESH
entries.description: Force a provider capability re-probe and reasoning backend re-selection

entries.name: KYBERION_PROVIDER_ENV_ALLOWLIST
entries.description: Provider child-process environment policy; allowlisting is enabled by default, while 0 is an explicit diagnostic escape hatch that passes through the parent environment.

entries.name: KYBERION_PROVIDER_HEALTH_STATE_PATH
entries.description: Override for the persisted provider-health state file (default active/shared/runtime/provider-health.json). Mainly for tests.

entries.name: KYBERION_PYTHON
entries.description: Python interpreter override for python-backed bridges.

entries.name: KYBERION_PYTHON_BIN
entries.description: Python interpreter path override (legacy alias of KYBERION_PYTHON call sites).

entries.name: KYBERION_REASONING_ALLOW_SHELL_TOOL
entries.description: Explicitly enables the shell_exec tool for reasoning profiles that request it; only the literal true enables the capability and the shell policy still applies.

entries.name: KYBERION_REASONING_BACKEND
entries.description: Reasoning backend selector. Common values: claude-cli (local claude CLI, no API key), anthropic (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY), codex-cli, agy-cli (Antigravity CLI), grok-cli (Grok Build CLI), grok-api (XAI_API_KEY or KYBERION_GROK_API_KEY), openrouter (OPENROUTER_API_KEY or KYBERION_OPENROUTER_KEY), stub (offline/deterministic tests). gemini-cli remains available for explicit Enterprise configurations.

entries.name: KYBERION_REASONING_MODEL
entries.description: Global fallback model override for reasoning routes.

entries.name: KYBERION_ROOT
entries.description: Repository root override for path resolution (defaults to the detected repo root).

entries.name: KYBERION_RUNWAY_API_KEY
entries.description: API key used by the explicit Runway video-generation backends.

entries.name: KYBERION_RUNWAY_VIDEO_URL
entries.description: Optional base URL override for the Runway video-generation API.

entries.name: KYBERION_SCOPE_ENV_PATH
entries.description: Override for the persisted operator scope binding file (default active/shared/runtime/scope.env).

entries.name: KYBERION_SECRET_ENCRYPTION
entries.description: At-rest encryption mode for connection documents (AC-05). none=plaintext (default, compatible); keychain=AES-256-GCM with a macOS-keychain-held key. Migrate with pnpm secrets:encrypt (--decrypt exports back to plaintext).

entries.name: KYBERION_SECRET_RESOLVER_COMMAND
entries.description: Command used by the secret resolver to obtain named secrets.

entries.name: KYBERION_SECRET_RESOLVER_TIMEOUT_MS
entries.description: Timeout in milliseconds for the external secret resolver command.

entries.name: KYBERION_SECURITY_POSTURE
entries.description: Security-screen posture override; accepted values are dangerous, auto, and strict. Invalid values are ignored and the schema-validated posture catalog is used.

entries.name: KYBERION_SHARE_GRANTS_HMAC_KEY
entries.description: HMAC key used to sign and verify share-grant records.

entries.name: KYBERION_SHELL_COMMAND_POLICY_PATH
entries.description: Optional path to the shell-command policy catalog used for command admission and injection-suspected restrictions; the policy is loaded through the governed catalog boundary.

entries.name: KYBERION_SILERO_VAD_MODEL
entries.description: Filesystem path to the Silero VAD ONNX model used by the local realtime voice bridge; when unset, the voice loop uses its configured fallback VAD path.

entries.name: KYBERION_SKIP_TYPE_RATCHET
entries.description: Skip type-ratchet validation for controlled image or context build runs; CI still enforces the ratchet.

entries.name: KYBERION_SMTP_HOST
entries.description: SMTP host that activates the email actuator SMTP mode; pair it with the separately managed SMTP credentials and keep outbound delivery within the approved egress boundary.

entries.name: KYBERION_SMTP_PASS
entries.description: SMTP password or app token used by the email actuator; provide it through the secret store and keep it out of logs and configuration artifacts.

entries.name: KYBERION_SMTP_PORT
entries.description: TCP port used by the email actuator SMTP backend; use the port required by the approved mail service, commonly 465 or 587.

entries.name: KYBERION_SMTP_USER
entries.description: SMTP username used by the email actuator; keep account identity configuration aligned with the approved outbound mail service.

entries.name: KYBERION_SOVEREIGN_SECRET
entries.description: Secret used by the sovereign pulse guard to sign and verify control payloads.

entries.name: KYBERION_SPEND_GUARD_TEST
entries.description: Test-only opt-in: lets vitest exercise the reasoning-path spend guard against real history/policy (normally disabled under VITEST).

entries.name: KYBERION_STT_COMMAND
entries.description: Speech-to-text bridge command override.

entries.name: KYBERION_STT_COMPUTE_TYPE
entries.description: Compute type passed to faster-whisper; CPU defaults to int8 and non-CPU devices default to float16.

entries.name: KYBERION_STT_DEVICE
entries.description: Device selected by the faster-whisper speech-to-text bridge, such as cpu or cuda.

entries.name: KYBERION_STT_LANGUAGE
entries.description: Language hint for local Whisper speech-to-text adapters; managed streaming adapters default to ja when unset.

entries.name: KYBERION_STT_MODEL
entries.description: Model identifier or size used by faster-whisper when STT_MODEL_DIR is not set.

entries.name: KYBERION_STT_WINDOW_SEC
entries.description: Audio window length in seconds for streaming Whisper adapters; defaults are adapter-specific.

entries.name: KYBERION_SUDO
entries.description: Authority escalation switch consumed by the policy engine; use only for explicitly approved operations.

entries.name: KYBERION_SUDO_KEY
entries.description: Key used by the system prelude for privileged sudo coordination; values stay in the secret store.

entries.name: KYBERION_SUDO_SCOPE
entries.description: Path scope restriction for KYBERION_SUDO escalation.

entries.name: KYBERION_SURFACE_ALLOWLISTS
entries.description: JSON actor allowlist keyed by surface (for example {"telegram":["actor-id"]}); an invalid configured value fails closed for the affected surface.

entries.name: KYBERION_SURFACE_QUERY_ROLE
entries.description: Fallback role selector for surface-query provider resolution; a request or server-resolved context role takes precedence and this value does not grant authorization.

entries.name: KYBERION_TASK_MODEL_ROUTING
entries.description: Task model-hint policy: advisory records routing hints without changing the manifest choice, while enforce applies a validated task model hint when present.

entries.name: KYBERION_TENANT
entries.description: Active tenant slug for tenant-scoped writes and branding.

entries.name: KYBERION_TENANT_DESIGN_ROOT
entries.description: Optional governed root for tenant design assets used by the Chronos tenant-design route; viewer-resolved tenant scope still controls which customer data is selected.

entries.name: KYBERION_TENANT_ID
entries.description: Legacy tenant identifier fallback used by peer and surface entrypoints; prefer the canonical KYBERION_TENANT slug and server-resolved viewer scope where available.

entries.name: KYBERION_TENANT_SCOPE_REQUIRED
entries.description: Tenant binding policy for confidential work; strict (or the boolean value 1/true where supported) rejects an unbound tenant, while warn records the migration warning.

entries.name: KYBERION_TERMINAL_HOST
entries.description: Bind host for the terminal bridge; the default is loopback so terminal control is not exposed remotely by default.

entries.name: KYBERION_TERMINAL_TOKEN
entries.description: Bearer token used to authenticate the terminal bridge.

entries.name: KYBERION_TRUST_PROXY
entries.description: Trust x-forwarded-for and x-real-ip as the client peer for local-surface detection. Keep disabled unless a trusted reverse proxy overwrites these headers.

entries.name: KYBERION_TTS_COMMAND
entries.description: Optional streaming text-to-speech executable for realtime voice and meeting flows; it reads newline-delimited UTF-8 text and emits PCM audio through the governed bridge.

entries.name: KYBERION_TTS_PLAY_COMMAND
entries.description: Optional PCM playback command used by the streaming TTS bridge; it overrides the platform default player and remains a local runtime configuration.

entries.name: KYBERION_VIEWER_SCOPE
entries.description: Chronos viewer tenant audit mode: off, warn, or enforce. Unregistered tenant expansion is denied in every mode; warn records the attempt first. Defaults to warn.

entries.name: KYBERION_VLLM_KEY
entries.description: API key for the vLLM OpenAI-compatible backend, when authentication is enabled.

entries.name: KYBERION_VLLM_MODEL
entries.description: Model identifier sent to the vLLM OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

entries.name: KYBERION_VLLM_URL
entries.description: Base URL for the vLLM OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

entries.name: KYBERION_WINDOWS_AI_ENDPOINT
entries.description: Foundry Local or other approved Windows local AI endpoint used by the Windows assistance bridge; keep the endpoint local or explicitly allowlisted.

entries.name: KYBERION_WINDOWS_AI_MODEL
entries.description: Model identifier selected by the Windows local AI bridge; it is paired with KYBERION_WINDOWS_AI_ENDPOINT and does not itself grant external access.

entries.name: KYBERION_WINDOWS_STT_BACKEND
entries.description: Selects the Windows speech-to-text backend, such as faster_whisper, for the local voice actuator; the selected backend must be installed and available in the governed runtime.

entries.name: KYBERION_WORKITEM_RESPONSE_TIMEOUT_MS
entries.description: Maximum milliseconds a mission work item waits for one provider response before recording a blocked result.
